name: Recovery time objective (RTO) and recovery point objective (RPO)
short_description: RTO defines how fast a system must be back online after a failure, and RPO defines how much data loss is acceptable; both are business requirements that drive resilient design.

evidence.quote: we have a recovery time objective and we have a recovery point of jitter
It's called RTO or Recovery Time Objective. That's the time it takes to get your systems back online after a disaster.
